speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are here due to changes in your behavior, eating habits, and weight gain. To understand what is happening, have you noticed any excessive thirst, frequent urination, or fatigue recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old male. The patient has demonstrated inappropriate behavior, including making unfitting comments and attempts to kiss strangers, over the past 6 months. He shows disinterest in family interactions and has developed a particular craving for chocolate pudding and potato chips, resulting in a 10 kg weight gain. The patient also presents as unkempt.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cushing's Syndrome. The combination of rapid weight gain, specific cravings for sweets/fats, behavioral changes, and unkempt appearance is highly suggestive of chronic hypercortisolism. I recommend ordering a 24-hour urinary free cortisol test and an ACTH stimulation test to confirm this.
